concurrentLoad.activity: A separate CI=1 software-Chrome smoke suite ran against port 3100 around 13:07–13:08 UTC.
concurrentLoad.overlap: The end of this run's 10-minute soak (minutes 9–10) overlapped that software-browser work. Heap/soak observations in this interval may reflect concurrent CPU pressure. The 60-second RAF sample ended around 12:58 UTC, before the reported concurrent suite.
concurrentLoad.limits: No cross-process CPU utilization trace was collected; overlap is recorded as a possible confound, not a measured causal effect.
concurrentLoad.testOutcome: Parent later reported four software-Chrome visit tests passed locally in 37.3 seconds; no app-source changes followed.

galleryScreenshots.initialLazyState: vi-design-initial-lazy.png preserves the initial full-page screenshot taken before scrolling; lower lazy images were not yet loaded.
galleryScreenshots.postScrollState: vi-design-scrolled-all-images.png is a separate post-soak headed capture; each of 16 image elements was scrolled into view and awaited decode plus complete/naturalWidth > 0.
galleryScreenshots.initialLoadAccounting: Scroll-triggered media transfers are separate and excluded from the cold initial route transfer and JS totals in results.json.

scope: Desktop preview evidence only; not parish-device acceptance, field performance, or engineering approval.
soakMemoryLimit: The soak sampled performance.memory JavaScript heap only. No WebGL/GPU memory counter was collected; one-canvas and JS-heap stability do not prove absence of a GPU memory leak.
